meta.title: XJTLU-MCP
meta.description: Adds the xjtlu campus assistant to DeepSeek Harness over Streamable HTTP. The xjtlu server exposes 16 read-only campus tools (timetable, exams, grades, attendance, library seats, and LMC files) from the local XJTLU-MCP workbench at http://127.0.0.1:39527/mcp. Authorization resolves from the XJTLU_MCP_TOKEN credential reference; keep the workbench running and the token set for tools to appear as mcp__xjtlu__*.
